"'May he live long,' says Lucinda softly."
"'You must try not to worry too desperately,' Lucinda says to the Prince in a comforting tone. 'I have heard only the best things about the doctors.'
"'It would have been better for us all if I had siblings,' says the Prince. 'My father feels it, I know.'"
